# quality.yaml reference

`quality.yaml` sits at the repository root. It is optional: without it, every check runs advisory with defaults. `qk` validates it against `plugins/quality-kit/schemas/quality.schema.json` (rule QK001).

| Key | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `1`; required | Manifest schema version. `qk` reads version 1. |
| `service` | string | Name of the service this repository builds. |
| `owners` | object | Who answers for this repository. |
| `owners.product` | string | Product owner. |
| `owners.tech` | string | Technical owner, usually a GitHub handle. |
| `data_class` | `internal`, `client` or `public` | The most sensitive data the service handles. |
| `maturity` | `bronze`, `silver` or `gold`; default `bronze` | Sets every check's default mode. Bronze enforces only manifest validity; silver also enforces docs impact, contracts, waivers, generated files and supply chain; gold enforces every check. |
| `modes` | map of check key to `off`, `advisory` or `enforced` | Overrides the default mode of a check. Each key is a check key from the rule reference (for example `docs.impact`). |
| `docs` | object | Where the docs live and which code changes they must follow. |
| `docs.root` | string; default `docs` | Docs folder. |
| `docs.diataxis` | `true` or `false` | Docs follow the Diátaxis structure: tutorials, how-to, reference and explanation. |
| `docs.roles` | list of strings | Reader roles the docs serve, for example `end-user`, `admin`, `developer`. |
| `docs.impact_map` | list of objects | Changed code paths and the docs that must change with them (QK010). |
| `docs.impact_map[].paths` | list of strings; required | Globs for code paths, for example `internal/config/**`. |
| `docs.impact_map[].docs` | list of strings; required | Globs for the docs that must change when those paths change. |
| `generated` | list of objects | Files that must equal their generator's output (QK020). |
| `generated[].file` | string; required | The generated file. |
| `generated[].cmd` | string; required | The command that generates it, run from the repository root. |
| `contracts` | object | Contract files checked for breaking changes. |
| `contracts.openapi` | list of strings | OpenAPI files (QK030). |
| `contracts.asyncapi` | list of strings | AsyncAPI files (QK031). |
| `contracts.odcs` | list of strings | Open Data Contract Standard files (QK032). |
| `security` | object | Where threat models and specs live. |
| `security.threat_models` | string | Threat model folder. |
| `security.specs_dir` | string | Spec folder. A new spec here needs a threat model (QK040). |
| `testing` | object | Human testing. |
| `testing.uat_dir` | string | UAT plan folder. |
| `testing.replaces` | list of strings | Tools this system replaces. When set, a parity matrix is required (QK051). |
| `ops` | object | Operational readiness. |
| `ops.runbooks` | string | Runbook folder; every alert must reference a runbook here (QK080). |
| `privacy` | object | Personal data. |
| `privacy.inventory` | string | Personal-data inventory file (QK070). |
| `feedback` | object | Where user feedback and follow-up work go. |
| `feedback.linear_team` | string | Linear team key. |
